name: Weft
description: Weft — the execution ledger for autonomous coding agents. Lease intents, edit a line-numbered workspace, and submit changes that land only when a verification gate's evidence and policy pass. Every landed line carries signed provenance to a human authority key. Talks to a weftd hub over HTTP; the agent's Ed25519 key never leaves the machine.

hub.description: weftd hub base URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8747 (or WEFT_HUB).

keyPath.description: Where this agent's Ed25519 seed lives. Created on first use; never transmitted. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/weft-agent.key (or WEFT_KEY).

model.description: Model tag recorded in each change's provenance. Defaults to WEFT_MODEL, else 'openclaw'.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout against the hub. Default 15000.

submitTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the gate's verdict after proposing. Default 20000.
